messages.content: Searches time out on node_modules. Look for 8px font sizes in app source css/ts only, excluding node_modules via find prune on ls of apps.

function.arguments: {"command": "cd /work && ls apps && timeout 20 grep -rnE '8px' apps/*/src 2>/dev/null | grep -iE 'admin|label|token' | head -30"}

messages.content: No 8px hits with those filters. Search app src for fontSize 8 / 8px near admin or role tokens.

function.name: bash
